notes: Set up the listener before firing: nc -lvnp <lport>. The socat and python3 variants give a fully interactive PTY. On Windows targets prefer the PowerShell one-liner or a msfvenom binary. Upgrade a dumb shell with the tty-shell-upgrade card.

recommended.note: Stabilize the dumb shell into an interactive PTY.

name: Reverse Shell One-Liners
description: Collection of reverse shell one-liners across common interpreters. Set up a listener first (nc -lvnp <lport>), then trigger the payload that matches whatever is installed on the target. Switch tabs for bash, nc, python, php, perl, ruby, socat and PowerShell variants.

variations.label: Bash (fd 196)
variations.description: Bash reverse shell using file descriptor 196 for the TCP connection. Alternative to the /dev/tcp method that works on some systems where the standard bash reverse shell fails.

variations.label: nc mkfifo
variations.description: Netcat reverse shell one-liner. Target connects back to your listener - works through NAT and most firewalls.
